name: PLANT GROWTH CHAMBER
desc: ISO and CE Certified Double-Walled Plant Growth Chamber engineered for high-precision simulation of ecological environments. Features a 340-liter SS304 internal volume, dynamic humidity control, and high-intensity 3-side illumination up to 23000 LUX driven by a weekly digital cycle timer.
features: Extended sub-ambient thermal spectrum from 5 to 60°C
Dynamic humidity control environment operating from 50% to 90% RH
High-intensity 3-side light distribution via detachable LED lighting blocks
Integrated 24×7 weekly programmable digital cycle timer module
Premium high-reliability EMERSON Copeland brand CFC-free compressor system

specifications.Equipment Configuration: High-Performance Double-Walled Laboratory Plant Growth Chamber
specifications.Primary Process Function: Controlled simulation of temperature, humidity, and lighting for botanical research
specifications.Volumetric Chamber Capacity: 340 Litre intermediate standard laboratory processing envelope
specifications.Chamber Internal Dimensions: Spacious clearance measuring exactly 600 mm x 600 mm x 900 mm (WxDxH)
specifications.Thermal Range (Lights Inactive): Extended sub-ambient thermal spectrum from 5 to 60 degrees C
specifications.Thermal Range (Lights Active): High-efficiency processing thermal spectrum from 10 to 60 degrees C
specifications.Temperature Control Method: Advanced Digital PID Controller displaying Set Value (SV) and Process Value (PV)
specifications.Temperature Tracking Accuracy: High-stability calibration holding tight within plus or minus 1 percent tolerance
specifications.Chamber Moisture Range: Dynamic humidity control environment operating from 50 percent to 90 percent RH
specifications.Humidity Control Method: Integrated Digital PID moisture loop controller tracking SV and PV matrices
specifications.Humidity Tracking Accuracy: Precise moisture stabilization calibrated within plus or minus 3 percent RH
specifications.Illumination Profile Layout: High-intensity 3-side light distribution via detachable LED lighting blocks
specifications.Luminous Intensity Output: Ultra-bright standard crop growth field configuration up to 23000 LUX
specifications.Light Sequencing Management: Integrated 24×7 weekly programmable digital cycle timer module
specifications.Air Circulation Mechanism: Forced air circulation loops via heavy-duty balanced axial fan arrays
specifications.Inner Chamber Build Material: Premium corrosion-resistant heavy-gauge polished Stainless Steel (SS304 Grade)
specifications.Outer Structure Build Material: Heavy-duty rugged Galvanized Iron (GI) steel sheets with powder coat finish
specifications.Chamber Core Insulation: 3 inch (70 mm) thick high-density polyurethane foam (PUF) insulation barrier
specifications.Double Door Configuration: Outer insulated solid door with lock plus inner toughened glass viewing door
specifications.Chamber Internal Gasketing: High-durability temperature-stable seamless Silicon Gaskets around doorways
specifications.Chamber Shelving System: Height-adjustable polished Stainless Steel specimen holding trays
specifications.Thermal Generation Element: Heavy-duty industrial-grade tubular air heating elements
specifications.Refrigeration Cooling Core: Premium high-reliability EMERSON Copeland brand CFC-free compressor system
specifications.Moisture Generation Engine: Heavy Stainless Steel boiler tank with high-durability immersion heating element
specifications.Fluid Replenishment Automation: Built-in automated water replenishment loop via external reservoir tanks
specifications.Integrated Safety Alarms: Automated audio and visual warning indicators for temperature deviations
specifications.Mobility Infrastructure Deck: High-load rolling Caster Wheels integrated with instant foot brake locks
specifications.Quality System Certifications: Formally certified to match ISO and CE global laboratory standards
specifications.Electrical Power Inputs: Standard 220 Volts, 50 Hz, Single Phase stable Indian plug mains connection
specifications.Warranty Cover Protection: 1 Year Comprehensive On-site Manufacturer Warranty on compressor and logic
